candidates.counter_evidence_explanation: Gateway trace shows one OK checkout at 65ms, so the latency is not yet reproduced end-to-end in traces.
missing_evidence: Order service db pool size, active connections and wait-time time series
Order-to-postgresql span latencies to confirm pool wait drives the 900ms p95
candidates.statement: Order service shows 12 db_pool_waiters with p95 latency of 900ms while gateway, inventory and payment stay at 79ms p95 and 0 waiters, indicating database connection pool saturation at order as the bounded latency source.
candidates.uncertainty: Single 5-minute window; no pool saturation time series or postgres span detail.

report.explanation: Order metrics are the only outlier: 12 db_pool_waiters and 900ms p95 versus 79ms and 0 waiters elsewhere, consistent with db-pool-exhaustion at order. Gateway traces/logs are healthy and the gateway deployment is old and valid, so deployment-caused latency is not supported. Pool-level detail is still needed to fully confirm.
